reviewers.basis: Only the ReviveCheck project's separate reviewer test account 0x95db300103ec8b45884b13ed85230fbf02114065 counts. The release owner 0x48b9e37a2a2c9621172745dc377b9fc6b9a6a71b and this reviewer are both controlled by the same project, so an approval shows on-chain role separation between two signers, not independent review. A production allow-list would name reviewers its operator does not control.

boundBy: allow-list operator (an AI agent on the author's machine); owner and reviewer are distinct accounts, both controlled by the ReviveCheck project

owner.control: the ReviveCheck project's development test account; it owns the pusd-catalog-v2 release and signed the listing

reviewer.control: the ReviveCheck project's separate reviewer test account; a distinct signer controlled by the same project, so this shows role separation, not independent review

operator.control: this repository's check command, run by an AI agent on the author's machine; it reads the chain and signs nothing

note: Test and CI fixture: identical to config/allowlist.json except entry.decimals, which is wrong on purpose. The approved report verified 6 decimals, so the check must deny with entry-mismatch:decimals even when the policy evaluation is valid.
